ruling.recommended_action: Issue a $3.78 Ryde voucher (unexempted detour mileage only; metered stop time is not refundable) and record the RD-1 violation on the driver's file; no account flag warranted.

segment_findings.reason: North-east out-and-back spur off the TPE (GPS 21:46:40→21:49:40: 1.39599,103.83124 → 1.39827,103.82891 → 1.40084,103.82775 → back to 1.39587,103.83158), ~0.9 km net extra not on the quoted polyline; no user override (RD-3) — the chat consent was only for a petrol stop the driver never made and never named — and no traffic incident or band 1–2 corroboration exists (RD-4), so the segment is unexempted and priced under RD-2: ~0.9 km × S$1.4102/km ≈ S$1.27 (upper bound 2.68 km × 1.4102 = S$3.78).

Petrol stop: rider consented before the deviation (RD-5, reply 21:44:10 precedes 21:46:40), but the driver never named the location and the GPS shows no stop, so no exemption applies under RD-3(a)/(b); no extra distance is attributable to this stop in the trace, so the driver's failure to stop does not alter the metered mileage refund (RD-3(c): metered stop time is not refundable).

rejected_claims.reason: RydeTAXI is metered, so RD-2's non-metered branch (no mileage refund on a fixed quote) does not apply; extra kilometres do enter the fare.
The metered stop/standstill time is chargeable under RD-3(c) and waiting_fee is 0.00; it is not an unexempted detour mileage item.
The only speed bands on the optimal line are SELETAR EXPRESSWAY band 4 and TAMPINES EXPRESSWAY band 5, neither of which is band 1/2, and there are no LTA incidents — no RD-4 reasonable cause.
driver route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0, so RD-6's repeated-violation precondition is not met.
